title.narrative: The number of Provincial Project Management Units, who perform satisfactorily, based on the evaluation score
Number of CHS built (new) or renovated with project support
Percentage of CHS using quality monitoring and management practices (in the form of a quality scorecard)
Number of districts in project provinces piloting at least one innovation
Number of CHS in the project provinces with the basic package of equipment needed to manage the tracer conditions (provided by theproject)
Number of health professionals at CHS level who have received in-service training (through the project) on the management of the tracer conditions.
Number of community people were publicly consulted before project interventions
Population utilization rate of CHS in the project provinces
People who have received essential health, nutrition, and population (HNP) services
Number of deliveries attended by skilled health personnel
Number of hypertension cases being managed at CHS level
Number of CHS in the project provinces authorized by the provincial DOH and provincial VSS to manage at least one of the new NCD tracer conditions (hypertension or diabetes) in the project provinces
Number of eligible women screened for cervical cancer at the CHS level
Percentage of CHS in the project provinces meeting national standards/benchmarks for structural quality
Number of NCD cases screened or being managed at the CHS level in project provinces
Number of diabetes cases being managed at CHS level
Number of women and children who have received basic nutrition services
Percentage of project provinces maintaining a full immunization rate above 90%
People who have received essential health, nutrition, and population (HNP) services - Female (RMS requirement)
